author: priya-raman
title: Store a rate id with every converted amount
body:
## What

Adds `rate_id` to `ledger_entries` and an append-only `fx_rates` table. Converted values are derived from the original amount and the rate with decimal arithmetic.

## Why

Reports must be reproducible. See the review notes on the multi-currency RFC and issue 251.

## Notes

- Rates are never updated. A correction is a new row.
- Integer minor units for amounts, `numeric(18,8)` for rates.

## Testing

Property test: converting then summing in any order gives the same total.
